headline: Weathered Expanse Casualties Soar; Fishermans Row Fights On
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse bloodletting has swollen still further: not a base there has changed hands, yet the latest hour brought upward of nine hundred Colonial and nearly fourteen hundred Warden casualties, both figures accelerating, with above twenty-one and twenty-three thousand apiece across the day. Fishermans Row remains the liveliest base front — nineteen actions in twenty-four hours, the latest scarce a minute before press, Fort Ember again the pivot — though its losses have cooled from the morning's peak; four works stand apiece there, one in ruins. Lykos Isle has stirred anew after a long stillness, two actions in the past two hours and twenty in the day, Fort Guile and The Squall the busiest posts. Tempest Island has been quiet since half past eight, Godcrofts since seven, Farranac Coast unmoved since four o'clock yet bleeding afresh, and the Dead Lands file no base report since late evening while losing above ten and thirteen thousand. Kings Cage, Marban Hollow and Loch Mor bleed at quickening rates; Clahstra's toll has slackened markedly. The ledger reads two hundred forty-four Colonial works to one hundred ninety-one Warden, a net work to the Colonial column since our last. It is the war's hundred-and-sixteenth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
